target_title: Colab-runnable notebooks with no local setup
note: Re-review after prior agent-rejected verdict (REVIEW-DL010, AC-2). AC-1 met: all 36 README Colab badges verified 1:1 against notebooks/ filenames (exact set match, no orphans either direction). AC-2 met: fix tasks TASK-DL040/TASK-DL041 added try/except-guarded %pip install cells for tokenizers (8b cell 11) and transformers (8b cell 19, 11b cell 17), matching the existing guard pattern used elsewhere (12b's peft install); a full-corpus static scan of all 36 notebooks for transformers/tokenizers/peft/datasets/accelerate/sentencepiece/bitsandbytes/einops/wandb/torchmetrics/torchtext/gensim/spacy/optuna/timm/safetensors/huggingface_hub imports found zero remaining notebooks with a non-preinstalled import lacking a pip-install cell. AC-3 met: full-corpus scan for hardcoded cuda device strings, .to('cuda'), and unguarded .cuda() calls found zero notebooks without a torch.cuda.is_available() guard. Note: the prior verdict's claim that scripts/verify_notebook.sh runs 'CPU-only' is unsupported -- the script sets no CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES pin and this host reports torch.cuda.is_available()==True, so verification actually ran with GPU available where present; this does not affect the criterion since AC-3 only requires GPU-optional, which the guard-pattern scan directly confirms independent of which device the verifier happened to use. Read in full: 0a/0b theory+practical (earliest), X4 (latest) per prior baseline; the other 34 notebooks judged via the exhaustive static scans above, which are stronger evidence for these three cross-cutting structural criteria than a reading sample would be.
